subject_session: sub-Achilles / ses-Achilles-10252013 (1.6 m linear maze, CA1)

headline_stat.name: none reported — run terminated before any phase-precession analysis

stated_limitation: Waiting on the background PSD computation to finish before selecting the theta channel.

justification.dataset: Dandiset 000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1, sub-Achilles 10252013) on a 1.6 m linear maze with simultaneous LFP, spikes, and linearized position is the canonical choice for theta phase precession.
justification.handling: Real data were streamed from the archive via remfile and the agent correctly diagnosed and corrected a 1000x error in the position SpatialSeries rate attribute, but the run-epoch and occupancy definitions remained visibly broken (single-bin place fields in check_corridor_fields.png) and the agent was still debugging them when the run ended.
justification.analysis: No theta phase was ever extracted and no precession analysis of any kind was performed; no script in the run mentions precession, so the analysis does not test the phenomenon that was asked about.
justification.correctness: No headline statistic, no slope, no entrainment fraction, and no numerical result bearing on phase precession was produced.
justification.figures: All eight figures are intermediate diagnostics of position, speed, and place fields; not one figure shows theta phase, spike phase, or precession.
justification.honesty: The run makes no claims whatsoever and its final statement accurately reports that it was still waiting on the theta-channel selection, so nothing is misrepresented, though there is no write-up that names limitations.
